coverage_interpretation: Availability estimated from Timing OFF master-facing captures, not measured switch arrival. This proxy omits effects of protected-path command holds and queue state. It cannot label protected transactions as unmodified or unobfuscated.

protocol.coverage: Master-facing Timing OFF availability proxy, averaging joint ACK/response inequalities over 16 equally likely quantized selections; no direct switch-arrival claim
protocol.criterion: ACK/CLRT fixed, adaptive and level-aware attacks; request-spacing results reported separately
protocol.level_aware: Nearest public timing-level subtraction; actual selected offsets excluded from features
protocol.selection: Smallest worst-operation added pooled median; tie by worst-operation p99 then smaller DA
protocol.stop_rule: 100 rounds; no outcome-dependent extension or policy changes
protocol.tuning: Five grouped folds within training rounds only; models frozen before test scoring
protocol.uncertainty: Shared paired-round bootstrap; maximum centered deviation across all policies and protected attacks

selection.scope: Lowest overhead among these four tested policies; not a global minimum or universal attacker guarantee

variance_interpretation: All valid samples retained, including long tails. Changes in variance and accuracy are associations, not causal attribution to deadline misses.
